title: Vue Todo App
description: Build a full CRUD todo application with Vue 3

steps.title: Setup Todo List
steps.description: Create a Vue app with a todos data array containing two items: { id: 1, text: 'Learn Vue', done: false } and { id: 2, text: 'Build a project', done: false }. Use v-for to render each todo's text in an <li>.

verification.failureMessage: Make sure both sample todos appear in the list

steps.title: Add a Todo
steps.description: Add a newTodo data field and bind it to an <input> with v-model. Add an 'Add' button with a @click handler that pushes a new todo object and clears the input. Use a unique id counter in data.
hints: Add method: addTodo() { this.todos.push({ id: this.nextId++, text: this.newTodo, done: false }); this.newTodo = ''; }

verification.successMessage: Form renders with input and button!
verification.failureMessage: Add an input with v-model and an Add button

steps.title: Toggle Done
steps.description: Add a toggleTodo method that toggles a todo's done state. Add @click on each <li>. When a todo is done, strike through its text using :style.
hints: Method: toggleTodo(id) { const t = this.todos.find(t => t.id === id); if (t) t.done = !t.done; }

verification.failureMessage: Add a toggleTodo method and apply line-through on done items

steps.title: Delete Todos
steps.description: Add a 'Delete' button next to each todo using v-on:click.stop to prevent triggering the toggle. Use a deleteTodo method that filters the array.

verification.failureMessage: Add a delete button to each todo item

steps.title: Filter with Computed
steps.description: Add a filter data field ('all', 'active', 'completed') with three buttons to change it. Use a computed property visibleTodos to filter the list based on the current filter.

verification.successMessage: Filters work with computed properties — you've built a full Vue Todo App!
verification.failureMessage: Add filter buttons and a computed property to filter todos
